en.title: It Can't Fly, Yet Glides 100 m. Can You Name It?
en.description: This is the Sunda flying lemur, or Malayan colugo. It is neither a lemur nor a flier: a skin membrane lets it glide about 100 m while losing under 10 m of height. Mothers carry their single young on the belly.
